page.overview:
What is Accu-accelerator?

An accu-accelerator was a component used in blasters, engines, and speeders. Accu-accelerators were used in starship ion engines. Some were scrounged by Jawa scavengers to construct their ion blasters; the components, along with a droid restraining bolt, were added to the blaster's firing mechanism. The accelerators were also used in Moll K-19T power generators.

Accu-accelerators were first mentioned in the canon continuity in the 2015 Dorling Kindersley reference book Ultimate Star Wars. They later appeared as upgrade materials in the 2024 video game Star Wars Outlaws developed by Massive Entertainment and published by Ubisoft.

Accu-accelerators were first mentioned in Star Wars Legends continuity in the 1991 roleplaying supplement, Cracken's Rebel Field Guide.
